denominator.unit: card × modeled odds variant contribution slot

rules: EV slot coverage percentage may be displayed only from the enumerated eligible contribution denominator.
Slot coverage is count-based and is not an EV-weighted estimate of economic completeness.
Probability-entry coverage must not be reused as EV slot coverage.
Market-audit coverage and original-marketplace verification remain separate gates.
Multi-team and team-unresolved cards remain excluded under the active break-allocation policy.
A zero-denominator category is not-applicable rather than not-started.
coverage_complete may only be true when every eligible contribution slot is valued.
